description: Weekly price history for one dairy product, from the same USDA MARS weekly dairy reports behind get_dairy_price. Use for trends across report weeks; use get_dairy_price instead when only the latest quote matters. Read-only lookup of stored reports; no API key. Each row carries date, price, unit and source, plus price_low/price_high and change_amount/change_pct when the source report publishes them (null otherwise). Default: up to `periods` most recent report rows, oldest first (default 30, max 365); geography defaults to US-Central and cheese defaults to geography 'Oceania'. Pass start_date and/or end_date (YYYY-MM-DD) instead to get every stored report inside that inclusive date range (max 1000 rows), returned as an object with the range actually returned and an observation count. Stored weekly reports currently reach back to 2026-07-20. Butter returns a withheld notice — USDA publishes only price differentials for butter, no US base price.

geography.description: Report region (US-Central, US-East, US-West; cheese uses US). Default: US-Central

periods.description: Number of most recent report rows to return (default 30, max 365). Ignored when start_date/end_date are given.

product.description: Dairy product (cheese, butter, dry_whey, fluid_milk). Butter prices are withheld — see description

start_date.description: Optional inclusive range start (YYYY-MM-DD). With start_date/end_date, returns all stored reports in range instead of the most recent `periods`.

name: get_dairy_history
